title: Analytical Procedures (Enantiomeric purity SM1)[Purity][CP-4]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Enantiomeric purity SM1)[Purity][CP-4].

action.title: Column
action.description: column of length 250 mm, internal diameter 4.6 mm ((type :coated polysaccharide chiral stationary phase) , 5 µm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 0.7 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent (same as mobile phase).

action.title: Identification solution
action.description: Approximately 0.7 mg/ml of CP-4 enantiomeric identification standard in diluent.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: The content of enantiomer is calculated according to following formula: Enantiomer (%) =(r1/rt)*100 ri =      Response of peak due to enantiomer in the test solution rt =     sum of the CP-4 and CP-4 enantiomer responses in the test solution Enantiomer (%) = Content of enantiomer in the substance, in %
